macros.name: aalph
macros.doc: \aalph is a variant of \alph which continues with the upper case letters for 27–52.

macros.name: definechange
macros.doc: The basic idea is that you can define a change with a specific version, date, and text using the \definechange command and then recall those parameters later using the \usechange command.

macros.name: describecsfamily
macros.doc: The \describecsfamily command is for marking out sections in text where a particular family of control sequences is described—just like \DescribeMacro does for individual commands.

macros.name: DoNotIndexBy
macros.doc: The \DoNotIndexBy command tells the commands that make index entries for macros to ignore a certain character sequence when the index entries are sorted.

macros.name: IfOddPageSituation
macros.doc: The \IfOddPageSituation macro is the user level test for whether the current page situation appears on an odd or an even page.

macros.name: IndexEntry
macros.doc: The \IndexEntry command writes one index entry to the .idx file.

macros.name: LevelSame
macros.doc: In the case of \LevelSame, the ⟨text⟩ is used both as sort key and contents of entry in the sorted index.

macros.name: MakeHarmless
macros.doc: The most important commands related to harmless character strings are \PrintChar, which is used for representing problematic characters, and \MakeHarmless, which converts arbitrary TeX code to the corresponding harmless character string.

macros.name: MetaNormalfont
macros.doc: The \MetaNormalfont command redefines \meta@font@select to do a \normalfont before the \itshape.

macros.name: NewDescribeCommand
macros.doc: There is also a companion command \NewDescribeCommand which defines new commands similar to \DescribeMacro and \DescribeEnv.

macros.name: PrintChar
macros.doc: The most important commands related to harmless character strings are \PrintChar, which is used for representing problematic characters, and \MakeHarmless, which converts arbitrary TeX code to the corresponding harmless character string.

macros.name: PrintCodelineNo
macros.doc: The \PrintCodelineNo command is the new recommended command for printing the formatted form of the codeline number counter.

macros.name: SendExternalXRefMsg
macros.doc: \SendExternalXRefMsg is the basic command for writing ExternalXRefMsgs to the .aux file, but it might be recommendable that XXR writers provide users with a set of commands that have more specific purposes.

macros.name: syncexternalxref
macros.doc: The \syncexternalxref command writes an ExternalXRefSync XXR-command for the current line number and value of the codelineno counter to .aux file.

macros.name: uintver
macros.doc: The \uintver command can be used in the ⟨version⟩ argument of \changes to ensure that (unsigned) integers are sorted in mathematical rather than ASCII order by makeindex.

envs.name: switch
envs.doc: The switch environment is for switches created by \newif (Plain TeX style).
